description: Synthetic fixture for the Web Runtime post-build gate. The feature marker is the sample project's package name — a literal we own that lands only in the feature's lazy chunk. Forbidden markers prove no dev-backend leak, no baked env VALUE (a real leak always includes the value after '='; the feature's own literal ends at '='), and no external publishing endpoints. Vendor-scoped: 'stackblitz.com' unavoidably ships inside @webcontainer/api itself (its OAuth constants — the library is a StackBlitz product), so it is allowed ONLY in the lazy chunk carrying the vendor signature; any other occurrence fails.
